summary: Thread-safe wrapper around the actual wide-to-multi-byte conversion sub_596089. Atomically increments the heap-lock counter dword_8D5A5C; if the locale-thread refcount dword_8D5A58 is non-zero, decrements the counter and enters critical section 19 for the conversion; otherwise stays outside the critical section. Calls sub_596089(lpMultiByteStr, WideCharStr) and returns its result, releasing the critical section or decrementing the counter on exit accordingly. Per-frame path (on_frame_path).

local_names.v2: flag: 1 if critical section 19 was entered, else 0

operations.description: InterlockedIncrement(&dword_8D5A5C): atomically raise the heap-lock counter before conversion.
If dword_8D5A58 (locale-thread refcount) is non-zero, take the locked path: InterlockedDecrement the counter, enter critical section 19 via CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter(19), and set v2 = 1.
WideCharStra = sub_596089(lpMultiByteStr, WideCharStr); perform the actual wide-to-multi-byte conversion.
On exit: if v2 is set, release critical section 19 via CritSectLeave(19); otherwise InterlockedDecrement the heap-lock counter.
Return the result of sub_596089 (the converted byte count / status).
